query_template:
select c.node_id,c.companyName,count(distinct a.node_id) contributionCount,count(*) path_count_diagnostic
from Agreement a join rel_REFERENCES rf on rf.src_id=a.node_id join Tdoc t on t.node_id=rf.dst_id
join rel_SUBMITTED_BY sb on sb.src_id=t.node_id join Company c on c.node_id=sb.dst_id
join rel_RESOLUTION_BELONGS_TO rb on rb.src_id=a.node_id join AgendaItem ai on ai.node_id=rb.dst_id
where {predicate} group by c.node_id order by contributionCount desc

numeric_component_AND_lexical_MIMO_paren.predicate: (ai.agendaNumber='7.1' or ai.agendaNumber like '7.1.%') and exists(select 1 from AgendaItem p where p.meetingNumber=ai.meetingNumber and lower(p.agendaDescription) like '%mimo%' and (p.agendaNumber=ai.agendaNumber or ai.agendaNumber like p.agendaNumber||'.%'))

lexical_MIMO_parent_without_numeric_limi.predicate: exists(select 1 from AgendaItem p where p.meetingNumber=ai.meetingNumber and lower(p.agendaDescription) like '%mimo%' and (p.agendaNumber=ai.agendaNumber or ai.agendaNumber like p.agendaNumber||'.%'))

explicit_NR_MIMO_parent_without_numeric_.predicate: exists(select 1 from AgendaItem p where p.meetingNumber=ai.meetingNumber and lower(p.agendaDescription) like '%nr mimo%' and (p.agendaNumber=ai.agendaNumber or ai.agendaNumber like p.agendaNumber||'.%'))
